name: meridian-air-lab
description: Meridian Air — Privilege in One Demo. The Agentic Trust Control Plane (AI Gateway, PingOne identity, Privilege, Authorize, Governance) told as one day at a fictional airline: 11 chat-first scenes, each started by a named agent, played as movie-reel hops (demo-hop/1). A simulation: a mock engine produces every token, hop and decision offline; an optional local llama.cpp brain picks scenes. No tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
